message:
fix(viewer): held-resume pending has one budget per episode, needs valid stamps, and ends with the episode

Review conditions on 1607404 (P11 viewer rule).

- A later held gap frame inside a pending spends the same budget; it no longer restarts
  the 8-frame / 500 ms window.
- Only valid stamps (send and capture non-zero, send >= capture) count as held or fresh; a
  missing or reversed stamp follows the pre-P11 rule and never starts or ends a pending.
- Pending ends on a keyframe wait, on a decoded keyframe (note_reference_sync) and on any
  congestion state change. The correction touches only the decode-queue ENTRY floor;
  stream-lag emergency, keyframe wait and stale drops are untouched.
- Tests: small host hold with a stalled renderer still trips (the host's age is not a
  viewer backlog); pending ends on keyframe wait / decoded key; unknown and reversed stamps
  use the old rule; repeated held gaps do not renew the budget.
